subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 22, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - September 22, 2026. Today marks another productive day for the AcreetionOS project as we continue pushing forward with our mission to deliver a privacy-focused, Arch-based Linux distribution. The team has made significant progress across multiple fronts, ensuring stability and feature parity with our latest releases. Read on for the key developments and community highlights.

Our development pipeline has seen several important commits this week, including fixes for compatibility issues with newer NVIDIA drivers and the removal of unnecessary disk encryption options. These changes improve system performance while maintaining the core philosophy of simplicity and transparency. The codebase remains actively maintained with regular contributions from our co-lead developers and the broader community.

We also introduced improvements to the Calamares installer configuration, allowing for smoother first-boot experiences and better handling of multi-user environments. Additionally, the Ember Vulkan integration was initially committed to address graphics acceleration needs for advanced users. These updates demonstrate our commitment to evolving the platform while staying true to its original
